content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Goa Estate Engineer (on Temporary Basis) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Goa to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Estate Engineer post at NIT Goa?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Estate Engineer (on Temporary Basis) position at NIT Goa is 28th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Estate Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First-class Bachelor's Degree or equivalent grade in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed for the Estate Engineer position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 07 years of relevant serving experience is required. This experience should be from PWD/CPWD/semi-Govt./Private/PSU/Autonomous organization/ University/ Institutes of national importance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Estate Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Estate Engineer post is 50 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Estate Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Estate Engineer position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 56,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Estate Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Estate Engineer post at NIT Goa will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications for the Estate Engineer position at NIT Goa must be submitted online through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or temporary position?
faq.answer: The Estate Engineer position is being recruited on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
